hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A binary sequence has equal counts of zeros and ones if its prefix sum (with 0 as -1 and 1 as +1) balances to zero.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Record the earliest occurrence of every prefix balance value.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: One swap of a 0 and a 1 outside or inside the interval allows matching prefix balances differing by +2 or -2.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass tracks prefix offsets and queries candidate shift balances in O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all O(n^2) swaps with substring balance checks takes O(n^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores first occurrence indices of each prefix balance value.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses prefix hash map with offset checks for one swap.
